name: Analisis de Codec de Video
description: Examina patrones de codificacion de video y artefactos de codec para detectar rastros de recodificacion y manipulacion.
useCase: Detecting video tampering through codec fingerprint and encoding history analysis
mechanism: Analyzes video container metadata, codec parameters, quantization patterns, and encoding artifacts. Manipulated videos often show signs of re-encoding (double compression artifacts), mismatched codec parameters, or encoding patterns inconsistent with claimed source devices.
accuracy: Medium-High - 73-85% on re-encoded and manipulated videos
source: Stamm, M. et al. (2012) - Anti-Forensics of Digital Image Compression, IEEE TIFS
algorithm: Container Analysis + Codec Parameter Extraction + Double Compression Detection + Encoding Pattern Matching
parameters: Codecs: H.264/H.265/VP9/AV1, QP analysis: block-level, GOP structure: reference frame pattern
